description: Ask the workspace's memory before acting. Evaluates intent against durable instructions, decisions, facts, preferences, active session threads, and grounded RAG documents. Zero conversation retention: query text is strictly ephemeral and never stored. Pass the recallId to 'report' so task outcomes sharpen what was recalled.

intent.description: What you are trying to do or know, in plain words

limit.description: How many matched memories to serve (default 5, max 20)

scopes.description: Array of authorized operational scopes to recall from

tags.description: Optional tags to filter or guide lexical matching

type.description: Optional memory type filter: instruction, decision, fact, or preference

name: recall
